series.name: F-family sensor codes (F0–F6, F8/F9, FA/FC/FE/FH)
series.notes: F-family sensors/refrigerant. NOTE: two valid Gree F-index mappings exist by series/region (official greecomfort F1=indoor ambient vs PK tables F0/F1 shifted) — see per-code notes; do not merge indices blindly.

title.en: Low refrigerant / leak protection or indoor sensor
title.ur: Gas kam hone ki hifazat ya indoor sensor kharab

meaning.en: Primary PK/retail mapping: system detected low refrigerant (leak path). Alternate Gree mapping (acguide): indoor ambient 20 kΩ sensor open/short.
meaning.ur: Zyada tar references mein: refrigerant kam ya leak ki nishani. Doosra Gree mapping (acguide): indoor ambient 20 kΩ sensor khul ya short.

causes.ur: Refrigerant leak hai ya gas kam hai
Sensor ki wiring open/short hai (alternate mapping)

solutions.en: Technician: leak search, repair, vacuum, weighed recharge
solutions.ur: Technician leak search kare, repair kare, vacuum kare aur taul kar gas bhare

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance vs temperature chart; replace sensor if out of spec
solutions.ur: Sensor ki resistance temperature chart se naapein; sensor spec se bahar ho to badlein

source.title: Cross-checked: greecomfort.com official F1–F5 vs aysonline/japanelectronics/electrafix full F-table vs acguide F0–F5 sensor ohm values

notes.en: Do not merge F-index across regions without model confirmation. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + heatpumpanswers.
notes.ur: Model confirm kiye bina F-index ko regions ke darmiyan merge na karein. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + heatpumpanswers.

title.en: Indoor ambient sensor fault (acguide index differs)
title.ur: Kamre ka ambient sensor kharab (acguide mapping alag)

meaning.en: Official: indoor ambient temperature sensor open/short. Widespread PK table agrees for F1 = indoor ambient in many lists; acguide shifts index by one.
meaning.ur: Official ke mutabiq indoor ambient temperature sensor khul ya short. Bohat se PK tables mein F1 = indoor ambient hai; acguide index ek aage shift kar deta hai.

causes.en: Open/shorted NTC sensor or damaged harness
causes.ur: NTC sensor open/short hai ya harness toota hua hai
Indoor board par connector dhila hai

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker and open the indoor panel; reseat the room-sensor connector on the indoor board
solutions.ur: Breaker par power band karke indoor panel kholein; room sensor ka connector indoor board par theek se lagayein

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance with a multimeter against the temperature chart and replace the NTC sensor if it reads open or short
solutions.ur: Multimeter se sensor ki resistance temperature chart se check karein; open/short de raha ho to NTC sensor badlein

source.title: Cross-checked: greecomfort.com official F1–F5 vs aysonline/japanelectronics/electrafix full F-table vs acguide F0–F5 sensor ohm values

notes.en: Index conflict noted in QUARANTINE. Per-code attribution: official + multi-pk.
notes.ur: QUARANTINE mein index conflict note kiya gaya hai. Per-code attribution: official + multi-pk.

title.en: Indoor coil sensor fault (majority PK; acguide differs)
title.ur: Andar wale coil ka sensor kharab (majority PK list)

meaning.en: Indoor coil (evaporator) temperature sensor open/short → erratic cycling or protection.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil (evaporator) ke temperature sensor ke khul ya short hone se cycling bhi arahi aur protection bhi ho sakti hai.

causes.ur: Evaporator ka NTC sensor fail ho gaya

causes.en: Wiring damage from icing or service
causes.ur: Icing ya service ki wajah se wiring ko nuksan pahuncha

solutions.en: Check resistance vs chart; replace sensor
solutions.ur: Pehle resistance chart se check karein; sensor spec se bahar ho to badlein

solutions.en: Ensure sensor seated in coil well, not iced
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke sensor coil well mein theek baitha hai aur barf nahi lagi

source.title: Cross-checked: greecomfort.com official F1–F5 vs aysonline/japanelectronics/electrafix full F-table vs acguide F0–F5 sensor ohm values

notes.ur: Is code ke sources official + multi-pk hain (per-code attribution).

title.ur: bahar ke darja hararat ka sensor kharab

meaning.en: Outdoor air temperature sensor open/short; efficiency and defrost logic degrade.
meaning.ur: bahar ka darja hararat sensor tota ya short hawa

causes.ur: Outdoor sensor par zang lagne ya kisi aur nuqsan ki wajah se kharab ho gaya
Outdoor unit par harness ghis gaya (chafing)

solutions.en: Disconnect supply and inspect the outdoor sensor harness at the outdoor unit for chafing or broken wires
solutions.ur: Supply band karke outdoor unit par sensor harness ko ghisne ya tootne ke liye inspect karein

solutions.en: Reseat the sensor connector, then test resistance and replace the outdoor sensor if it reads open or short
solutions.ur: Sensor connector dobara lagayein, phir resistance test karein; open/short aaye to outdoor sensor badlein

source.title: Cross-checked: greecomfort.com official F1–F5 vs aysonline/japanelectronics/electrafix full F-table vs acguide F0–F5 sensor ohm values

notes.en: Highest cross-source agreement in F family. Per-code attribution: multi-pk (all tables agree F3).
notes.ur: F family mein sabse zyada sources agree karte hain. Per-code attribution: multi-pk (all tables agree F3).

title.en: Outdoor coil or discharge tube sensor (varies)
title.ur: Bahar wala coil ya discharge tube sensor (model ke mutabiq)

meaning.en: Official greecomfort: outdoor tube sensor. Many PK tables: outdoor pipe/coil sensor; acguide: compressor discharge tube 25 kΩ; heatpumpanswers: discharge tube.
meaning.ur: Official greecomfort ke mutabiq outdoor tube sensor. Bohat se PK tables: outdoor pipe/coil sensor; acguide: compressor ki discharge tube 25 kΩ; heatpumpanswers: discharge tube.

causes.ur: NTC open/short ho gaya hai
Sensor well mein contact theek nahi hai

solutions.en: Isolate power and check that the tube sensor sits firmly in its well with good contact
solutions.ur: Power isolate karke dekhein ke tube sensor uski well mein theek se baitha hai aur contact acha hai

solutions.en: Test sensor resistance against the chart and verify the harness to the outdoor board; replace the sensor if it is out of spec
solutions.ur: Sensor ki resistance chart se test karein aur outdoor board tak harness verify karein; spec se bahar ho to sensor badlein

source.title: Cross-checked: greecomfort.com official F1–F5 vs aysonline/japanelectronics/electrafix full F-table vs acguide F0–F5 sensor ohm values

notes.en: Ambiguous target (outdoor tube vs discharge) across official vs other sources. Per-code attribution: multi (meaning variant by model).
notes.ur: Official aur doosre sources ke darmiyan target alag hai (outdoor tube ya discharge) — model ke mutabiq meaning badalti hai. Per-code attribution: multi (meaning variant by model).

title.ur: Compressor discharge ya wired controller ka sensor

meaning.en: Official: discharge sensor. acguide: wired-controller temperature sensor (replace controller). PK lists often “exhaust/discharge sensor.”
meaning.ur: Official ke mutabiq discharge sensor; acguide ke mutabiq wired-controller temperature sensor (controller badalna hota hai); PK lists mein aksar 'exhaust/discharge sensor' likha hota hai.

causes.en: Failed discharge NTC (critical for compressor protection)
causes.ur: Discharge NTC fail ho gaya (compressor ki hifazat ke liye zaroori hai)
Wired controller ka sensor/board kharab hai

solutions.en: Technician: replace sensor — never bypass discharge sensor
solutions.ur: Technician sensor badlein — discharge sensor kabhi bypass na karein

solutions.en: If wired-controller variant: replace controller unit
solutions.ur: Agar wired-controller version hai to controller unit badlein

source.title: Cross-checked: greecomfort.com official F1–F5 vs aysonline/japanelectronics/electrafix full F-table vs acguide F0–F5 sensor ohm values

notes.en: Maqsood: “Never bypass this sensor.” Per-code attribution: official + multi-pk.
notes.ur: Maqsood: is sensor ko kabhi bypass na karein. Per-code attribution: official + multi-pk.

title.en: Outdoor mid-tube sensor / overload limit frequency drop
title.ur: Outdoor middle tube sensor / overload limit ki wajah se frequency drop

meaning.en: Sources split: outdoor middle tube sensor fault vs overload-limit causing frequency reduction (sometimes fan slow + coil issue/leak).
meaning.ur: Sources do baatein batate hain: outdoor middle tube sensor ki kharabi, ya overload limit ki wajah se frequency kam hona (kabhi kabhi fan bhi dheema aur coil ki kharabi ya leak bhi hota hai).

causes.ur: Outdoor tube sensor open/short ho gaya

causes.en: System overload, dirty filters, possible refrigerant issue
causes.ur: System par overload, gande filter, ho sakta hai refrigerant ka masla

solutions.en: Clean filters/coils; verify charge
solutions.ur: Pehle filters/coils saaf karein; charge verify karein

solutions.en: Technician: test F6 sensor and replace if bad
solutions.ur: Technician F6 sensor test kare aur kharab ho to badle

source.title: Cross-checked: greecomfort.com official F1–F5 vs aysonline/japanelectronics/electrafix full F-table vs acguide F0–F5 sensor ohm values

notes.en: airconditioningmanuals claims F6 = capacitor overheat at low fan — quarantined. Per-code attribution: multi-pk (split meanings).
notes.ur: airconditioningmanuals ka kehna hai F6 = low fan par capacitor overheat — quarantine kiya gaya. Per-code attribution: multi-pk (split meanings).

meaning.en: Drive detected overcurrent condition and reduced compressor frequency.
meaning.ur: Drive ne current zyada hone ki condition detect ki aur compressor ki frequency kam kar di.

causes.ur: Electric supply ya wiring mein masla hai
Compressor ya drive component kharab hai

solutions.en: Switch off the unit and check supply voltage and all power connections for looseness before any probing
solutions.ur: Unit band karke pehle supply voltage aur saare power connections ki tightness check karein, phir probing karein

solutions.en: A technician inspects the drive and compressor windings with a meter and replaces the failed drive or compressor part
solutions.ur: Technician meter se drive aur compressor winding check kare aur kharab drive ya compressor part badle

source.title: Cross-checked: greecomfort.com official F1–F5 vs aysonline/japanelectronics/electrafix full F-table vs acguide F0–F5 sensor ohm values

notes.ur: Is code ka source multi-pk hai (per-code attribution).

title.ur: Discharge high temperature ki had (frequency drop)

meaning.en: Discharge temperature high enough that the controller derates compressor speed.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature itni zyada ho gayi ke controller ne compressor ki speed kam kar di.

causes.ur: Condenser ki ventilation kamzor hai
Gas charge kam hai ya flow roka hua hai

solutions.en: Power off, clean the condenser and filters, and clear space around the outdoor unit so airflow returns
solutions.ur: Power band karke condenser aur filters saaf karein, outdoor unit ke aas paas jagah khali karein taake airflow wapas aaye

solutions.en: Let the unit cool and restart; if the code repeats, a technician checks the charge for a leak and repairs it
solutions.ur: Unit ko thanda hone dein aur restart karein; code dobara aaye to technician leak ke liye charge check kare aur repair kare

source.title: Cross-checked: greecomfort.com official F1–F5 vs aysonline/japanelectronics/electrafix full F-table vs acguide F0–F5 sensor ohm values

notes.ur: Is code ka attribution multi-pk sources par hai.

title.ur: Tube over temperature ki hifazat (frequency drop)

meaning.en: Heat-exchanger tube temperature exceeded limit; controller reduces frequency.
meaning.ur: Heat exchanger ki tube ka temperature had se zyada ho gaya; controller ne frequency kam ki.

causes.ur: Zyada garmi, ganda coil, sensor ka drift

causes.en: Blocked filters or poor airflow around the heat exchanger
causes.ur: Filter band hain ya heat exchanger ke gird airflow kam hai

causes.en: Tube temperature sensor drifted high and reports a false over-temperature
causes.ur: Tube temperature sensor zyada reading de raha hai jis se galat over-temperature show hota hai

solutions.en: Shut down and isolate supply, then clean the heat-exchanger coil and filters and clear anything blocking airflow
solutions.ur: Unit band karke supply isolate karein, phir heat-exchanger coil aur filters saaf karein aur airflow rukne wali cheezein hatayein

solutions.en: Restart after cooldown; if FA returns, a technician verifies the tube-sensor reading and the refrigerant charge
solutions.ur: Thanda hone ke baad restart karein; FA wapas aaye to technician tube sensor ki reading aur refrigerant charge verify kare

source.title: Cross-checked: greecomfort.com official F1–F5 vs aysonline/japanelectronics/electrafix full F-table vs acguide F0–F5 sensor ohm values

meaning.en: Access door/panel switch reports open or faulty state (cassette/floor models).
meaning.ur: Access door/panel switch khula ya kharab state bata raha hai (cassette/floor models).

causes.ur: Koi cheez ruki hui hai jo puri tarah band nahi hone deti
Door switch fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Power off, open the panel, and remove anything stopping the access door from closing fully
solutions.ur: Power band karke panel kholein aur us cheez ko hatayein jo access door ko puri tarah band hone se rok rahi hai

solutions.en: Check the door switch with a meter for continuity and replace it if it stays open when the door is shut
solutions.ur: Door switch ko meter se continuity ke liye check karein; door band hone par bhi open rahe to switch badlein

source.title: Cross-checked: greecomfort.com official F1–F5 vs aysonline/japanelectronics/electrafix full F-table vs acguide F0–F5 sensor ohm values

meaning.en: Sensor monitoring compressor overload is open/short or implausible.
meaning.ur: Compressor ke overload par nazar rakhne wala sensor khul ya short hai, ya uski reading qabil-e-taweeq nahi.

causes.ur: Overload sensor ya uski wiring fail ho gayi
Compressor mein electrical kharabi hai

solutions.en: Disconnect power and check the overload-sensor connector and wiring for damage before testing
solutions.ur: Power disconnect karke test se pehle overload sensor ka connector aur wiring ki damage check karein

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance against the chart and replace the sensor if open or short; if the code stays, a technician evaluates the compressor
solutions.ur: Sensor ki resistance chart se naapein aur open/short ho to sensor badlein; code rahe to technician compressor evaluate kare

meaning.en: Evaporator approached freezing; controller derates compressor to prevent ice-up.
meaning.ur: Evaporator jam ki taraf ja raha tha, is liye controller ne compressor ki frequency kam ki taake ice na lage.

causes.en: Low ambient / low airflow / low refrigerant
causes.ur: Kam ambient temperature / kam airflow / kam refrigerant
Coil sensor kharab hai

solutions.en: Clean filters; verify airflow and charge
solutions.ur: Pehle filters saaf karein; airflow aur charge verify karein

solutions.en: Replace coil sensor if out of range
solutions.ur: Coil sensor range se bahar ho to badlein
